Predicting accuracy. Given the resource-intensive nature of producing language models, especially the most capable models (for which we take accuracy for different scenarios as a proxy), the ability to predict model capabilities65 is valuable for orienting decision-making. Prior work demonstrates model scale (whether measured in model size, data size, or compute/training FLOPs) reliably predicts model loss for language models, establishing scaling laws (Kaplan et al., 2020; Hoffmann et al., 2022).
